title: Config
description: The serialized top-level configuration for TurboZone.

Pattern.description:
An exact string or a conjunction of nonempty literal partial patterns.

Serialized and compiled literals share [`SmolStr`] so parsing, validation, and
runtime matching keep one owned representation without changing their wire format.

anyOf.description: Exact match against the entire string.
Several non-empty partial predicates which are ANDed.

contains.description: Required substring, or an empty string when omitted.

ends_with.description: Required suffix, or an empty string when omitted.

starts_with.description: Required prefix, or an empty string when omitted.

ProgramFilter.description: Program filters using serialized patterns or compiled predicates.

anyOf.description: Resizing disabled or selector enabled without any size filters.
Exact target size. The selector is disabled in this mode.

exact.description: Supported client-area `[width, height]` in physical pixels, independent of selector limits.

anyOf.description: Selector properties with only a default size, no minimum, and no maximum.
Selector properties, including optional default, minimum, and maximum sizes.

ResizeSelector.description: Selector defaults and inclusive bounds; omitted bounds are unrestricted.

default.description: Primary `[width, height]` in physical pixels, independent of selector bounds.

max.description: Maximum `[width, height]` offered by the selector, in physical pixels.

min.description: Minimum `[width, height]` offered by the selector, in physical pixels.

Rule.description: One serialized rule pairing window filters with the actions they enable.

description.description: Compact user-facing section name, falling back to the rule name when empty.

move.description: Relocation controls, currently only the "center" button.

name.description: Unique stable identifier retained in the same compact representation at runtime.

priority.description: Higher priorities take precedence; zero is the default.

resize.description: Resize controls, target, and selector limits.

WindowFilter.description: Window filters using serialized patterns or compiled predicates.

max.description: Inclusive maximum client-area `[width, height]` in supported physical pixels.

min.description: Inclusive minimum client-area `[width, height]` in supported physical pixels.
